konteks: Quantitative research and portfolio decision-support system for the Indonesia Stock Exchange (IDX)
ringkas: A modular research workflow combining market-regime analysis, technical and fundamental factors, machine-learning signals, portfolio construction, and risk controls to support transparent investment research.
hasil: IDX equity-universe screening and data-quality checks
Market regime classification and sector-level context
Technical and factor signals, including momentum, trend, and volume
Machine-learning experiments using XGBoost and out-of-sample evaluation

konteks: Automated equity-research workflow for Indonesian listed companies
ringkas: A Telegram-led research assistant designed to turn a stock ticker request into a structured equity-research report, combining quantitative signals, fundamental context, market data, and analyst-style commentary.
hasil: Telegram command workflow for ticker-based research requests
Technical and fundamental research sections
Foreign-flow, broker-summary, sector, and market-regime context where data is available
AI-assisted synthesis and scoring with explicit caveats

konteks: Streamlit application · IDX and US equity research
ringkas: Interactive equity research combining market data, fundamental analysis, DCF valuation, configurable sensitivity analysis, scenario analysis, and downloadable Excel/PDF reports.
hasil: Research coverage for Indonesian (IDX) and US-listed equities
Fundamental metrics and financial-statement context
DCF valuation and WACC / growth sensitivity analysis
Scenario analysis with downloadable Excel and PDF reports
catatan: Research support only · not investment advice. Verify data and assumptions independently.

konteks: Streamlit application · multidisciplinary scholarly paper and journal discovery
ringkas: A research-discovery tool for finding scholarly papers and potential journals for publication using OpenAlex metadata.
hasil: Paper Finder for multidisciplinary scholarly literature discovery
Journal Finder to explore journals, publishers, ISSN, citation and open-access metadata
Search results with paper and journal links
CSV and Excel export for further screening and review

konteks: Financial modeling and investment decision support for mining and heavy-equipment projects
ringkas: A suite of mining-finance concepts and tools connecting operational assumptions with project cash flow, valuation, commodity sensitivity, and stochastic risk analysis.
hasil: Project cash-flow modeling and capital budgeting
NPV and IRR evaluation
Commodity-price, production, and cost sensitivity analysis
Scenario and Monte Carlo risk modeling

konteks: AI-assisted project controls for construction, infrastructure, and mining projects
ringkas: A proposed workflow to convert project documents and progress data into structured cost, schedule, resource, risk, and performance insights for project teams.
hasil: Drawing and document intake as a future workflow input
BOQ and cost-estimate structuring
Baseline schedule, progress tracking, and critical-path review
Earned Value Management indicators including PV, EV, AC, SPI, and CPI

judul: Rotasi aset berbasis rezim VIX (TLT, GLD, SPY)
konteks: MScFE 622 Stochastic Modeling · proyek kelompok bersama 2 rekan
ringkas: Memodelkan rezim volatilitas dari perubahan VIX dengan rantai Markov dan Gaussian HMM (EM dan Viterbi), lalu menguji aturan rotasi: tahan aset dengan rata-rata return tertinggi di setiap rezim.
hasil: 5.520 observasi harian, 2004–2026.
Dalam sampel (dengan hindsight): Sharpe 1,16 vs 0,65 untuk SPY; drawdown maksimum −24,0% vs −55,2%.
Uji out-of-sample kausal: Sharpe 0,47 vs 0,85 untuk SPY.
catatan: Kesimpulan laporan: keunggulan tidak konsisten di luar sampel, sehingga strategi tidak direkomendasikan menggantikan benchmark. Manfaat paling masuk akal adalah drawdown yang lebih kecil.

konteks: Aplikasi Streamlit · Excel → model Python → memo investasi
ringkas: Alur dari workbook Excel ke data tervalidasi, model Python, audit trail, dashboard, dan memo investment committee dalam format DOCX.
hasil: DCF dengan sensitivitas WACC dan growth; LBO dengan debt schedule, cash sweep, dan covenant.
Cap table VC multi-putaran dengan liquidation preference.
Monte Carlo MOIC dan IRR (P5 sampai P95) serta register temuan due diligence.
catatan: Data bawaan bersifat ilustratif. Alat bantu analisis awal, bukan pengganti due diligence; batasan model dicantumkan di README.

konteks: Server lokal tanpa dependensi, cukup Python 3.8+
ringkas: Memantau emiten bursa Indonesia dengan data Yahoo Finance (.JK) yang diperbarui di latar belakang setiap 5 detik, dikelompokkan per sektor dan grup konglomerasi.
hasil: Endpoint snapshot, detail emiten, berita, pemegang saham, dan broker.
Agregasi berita dari sumber RSS.
Impor CSV pemegang saham dan broker (maksimal 5 MB).
catatan: Memakai data Yahoo Finance, bukan data resmi bursa.

ringkas: Terminal riset kuantitatif lokal untuk saham global dan IDX: backtest, walk-forward, portofolio, Monte Carlo, stress test, dan panel order flow.
hasil: Enam strategi: SMA, breakout, RSI, MACD, OBV, dan Bollinger Bands.
Aturan pasar IDX: tick size, lot, batas auto-rejection, dan daftar LQ45 contoh.
Data riil lewat yfinance atau API pihak ketiga dengan anggaran request lokal; tanpa data memakai data simulasi.
Panel order flow: antrean bid/ask dan sisi agresor transaksi.
catatan: Berjalan penuh di browser dengan data simulasi (bukan kuotasi pasar). Alat riset, bukan saran investasi.

konteks: Dari lembar Excel ke Python, dengan versi web di halaman ini
ringkas: Menghitung biaya dan margin per ret untuk kontraktor hauling tambang.
hasil: Fuel ratio, pendapatan, serta biaya solar, unit, dan driver.
Profit kotor, profit bersih setelah fix cost, dan titik impas harga kontrak.

judul: TSFA Dual Market V1.3 – Portfolio Engine
konteks: Python & Streamlit – Indonesian and US equity portfolio analysis
ringkas: Portfolio decision-support engine untuk mencatat transaksi, menganalisis kinerja, mengukur risiko, mengevaluasi alokasi aset, dan menyusun strategi rebalancing untuk pasar saham Indonesia dan Amerika Serikat.
hasil: Portfolio tracking berbasis transaksi dengan moving weighted-average cost.
Analisis return, drawdown, volatilitas, dan kontribusi risiko.
Target allocation dan rebalancing analysis.
Sector exposure dan sector stress testing.
Market stress testing dan analisis skenario.
Ekspor laporan analisis ke Excel dengan 13 worksheet.
catatan: Live application. Data portofolio pengguna diproses dalam session Streamlit dan dipisahkan dari repositori publik.
